complete_records.energy_readout: Spectral measure of the full autonomous operator; all energy complements retained, zero nonselective energy work.
complete_records.field_preparation_work: The Gauss-dressed n=0 service has field energy Tr(rho_matter V0)+b, hence field energy above the true vacuum Tr(rho_matter V0)+b-E_gamma in [Tr(rho_matter V0),Tr(rho_matter V0)+b].
complete_records.general_full_matter_input: Retain its actual native charge-square expectation Tr(rho_matter V0); the uniform-quartet values do not replace this full-input expectation.
complete_records.preparation: Full native uniform fixed-N singlet input and n=0 field service; quartet success, entire matter complement, every nonzero-flux failure and constraint failure retained.
complete_records.zero_charge_vacuum_field_service_only: For rho supported on all Q_x=0, V0=0 and this contribution lies in [0,b]. This is not the total charged preparation work.

declared_extension.W: Exact Gauss isometry on every native Fock occupation and every integer cycle flux, with R=-3Q_total.
declared_extension.additional_external_positive_hopping: Not added; all native nuclear hopping and charge-exchange terms receive the exact same tree dressing.
declared_extension.external_compensating_reference_Hamilton: 0, a declared apparatus term; its charge record is retained.
declared_extension.field_H: (a/2) sum E_edge^2 + b(1-Re U_loop), a=1/16,b=1/8, with full integer rotors.
declared_extension.field_coefficients_from: Exact architecture coefficients of openwave_transverse_completion; no alpha or nuclear target selects them.
declared_extension.full_operator: W (H_native tensor I_cycle) W* + H_field - E_gamma.
declared_extension.native_nuclear_source: Same complete fixed-N colour-singlet three/four-cell source, all rational strong and triton coefficients unchanged.
declared_extension.spatial_graph: Cycle on the same cells; the original open-chain native terms are dressed along its spanning tree.

effective_operator.P_to_high_matter_Q_electric_coupling_exa: 0; native charge is diagonal and preserves every local colour/spin block.
effective_operator.cycle_flux_generalization: (a/2) sum_e [n-3 sum_(x>e) Q_x]^2 with final edge E=n.
effective_operator.full_retardation_and_polarization: The magnetic shifts n to n+/-1 are retained in the source; no static elimination is used for the full ground lower bound.

positive_field_obstruction.operator_inequality: H_field-E_gamma >=0 on the full kinematic field; hence H_physical >= W(H_native tensor I)W*.

scope: An exact compact-Gauss extension with the inherited electron conversion, full dynamical cycle field and rigorous native nuclear ground bounds. The positive-extension class cannot cure the alpha mass excess; a Coulomb kernel or a retuned self-energy is not substituted for the full field.
